description: This file defines a React component named ExecutionViewTabs, which provides a user interface for monitoring and interacting with workflows and executions. It includes functions for data fetching, filtering, sorting, and navigation, and renders tabs for different views (executions, workflows, sessions, agents) with associated tables and controls.
